result.question: Why is a donkey's head expensive?

readings.answer: Because the city was besieged for a long time.
readings.support: they besieged the city so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver

readings.answer: Because there was a great famine in Samaria.
readings.support: there was a great famine in Samaria | a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver

assessments.reason: The text links the price directly to the siege duration: “they besieged the city so long that a donkey’s head sold for eighty shekels of silver,” making the long siege a valid cause.
The passage states “there was a great famine in Samaria,” which reasonably explains the high price and matches the key’s cause.

result.reason: The passage supports two distinct causes—the long siege and the great famine—either of which can explain the high price.
